sources.description: The NASA DPW8 ONERA OAT15A directory lists Cadence, Helden, ONERA-Deck and ONERA-Rizzi grid directories. These are independent grid lineages and must not be silently mixed or assumed equivalent.

The Test_Case_2 README associates alpha-labelled grids (2.50 to 4.25 degrees) with CRM wing deformation measured at M=0.85 in a low-dynamic-pressure ETW test condition. It states horizontal tails were removed before gridding and that farfield surfaces in source geometry were extended during grid generation. Original geometry and gridded geometry must be separately hashed and mapped.

The Static_Deformation Test_Case_2 FEM_Models README identifies NASA_CRM_FULLSPAN_WBT0.REV00 as sourced from the NASA Common Research Model site and NASA_CRM_HALFSPAN_FEM.REV00 as generated for DPW8/AePW4 (semispan model). The model files, revisions, units, materials, boundary conditions and coupling conventions remain uninspected.

NASA DPW8 buffet directory lists separate Test_Case_2 and Test_Case_3 data families. Exact flow conditions, time-resolved outputs, model setup and measurement references must be extracted from the task readmes before use.

NASA DPW8 Test_Environment directory lists Test_Case_1, Test_Case_2 and Test_Case_3. Exact facility, boundary-condition, calibration, support/tare and uncertainty artifacts must be identified before using this source family.

Official DPW8 verification activity defines V1a ONERA OAT15A grid convergence and polar as a required steady CFD/RANS task. A six-member grid family is defined (four required, six desirable). Conditions: Mach 0.73, chord Reynolds number 3e6, static temperature 271 K; alpha values 1.36, 1.50, 2.50, 3.00 and 3.10 degrees.

JAXA's joint DPW-AePW database describes Test Case 2 as unsteady CFD on a rigid/static wing using in-tunnel measured deformed geometries and experimental data; Test Case 3 is unsteady CFD with dynamic wing structural response/fluid-structure interaction. The exact geometry/data files, conditions, units and terms remain unpinned.

Official DPW8/AePW4 postprocessing page specifies Tecplot-readable ASCII submissions with dataset-identifying auxiliary metadata. Templates include convergence v5, forces/moments v5, surface cuts v5, unsteady time series v5, spectra v6, grid metrics v5, plus contour, spanwise load, boundary-layer and bending/twist outputs.

representation_reconciliation.interpretation: The version-5 file lists the same 20 grid/angle results once grouped by grid level and once grouped by angle. Treat the two blocks as alternate views, not 40 independent observations.

unresolved_anomaly.notes: The alpha=3.1 grid-level-3 CL/CD pair is effectively identical to the grid-level-3 alpha=1.5 pair despite materially different angles. It is also a large discontinuity from adjacent grid levels. This is an anomaly requiring participant/workgroup adjudication; the available source does not establish its cause.
